papers.title: Indocyanine green fluorescence angiography for prevention of anastomotic leak in colorectal surgery: a graded systematic review and meta-analysis with trial sequential analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Albashier M, Al Sayed M, Altabbaa H, Hih N, Maged M, Lebda N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leak (AL) is a major driver of morbidity after colorectal resection. Indocyanine-green fluorescence angiography (ICG-FA) provides real-time intraoperative perfusion assessment, but its impact across randomized trials remains debated. This review aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ICG-FA compared with conventional intraoperative assessment in preventing AL in colorectal surgery.
METHODS: A systematic review and a meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines, including RCTs comparing ICG-FA with conventional assessment. The primary outcome was overall AL; secondary outcomes included leak grade, anatomic location, operative metrics, and change in surgical plan (CISP). Pooled risk ratios (RR) or mean differences (MD) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated using random- or fixed-effects models. Trial sequential analysis (TSA) was used to evaluate evidence sufficiency.
RESULTS: Eight RCTs (n = 4712) met the inclusion criteria. ICG-FA reduced overall AL versus control (risk ratio [RR] 0.68, 95% CI 0.58-0.81; I2 = 0%). The absolute risk reduction was 3.6%, yielding a number needed to treat of around 24 to prevent one leak. TSA crossed the superiority boundary for the primary endpoint, indicating sufficient evidence of the assumed control risk and effect size. Benefits were more apparent for left-sided anastomoses and for lower-grade leaks (A and A + B), whereas severe (Grade C) leaks and reoperation did not differ significantly. Overall complications showed a small relative reduction, but TSA indicated insufficient information size. Other safety outcomes (surgical site infection, ileus, mortality) were similar between groups.
CONCLUSIONS: High-certainty evidence demonstrates that ICG-FA reduces overall and low-grade AL, principally in left-sided resections, without prolonging operative time. ICG-FA should be considered an evidence-based adjunct to optimize perfusion assessment in colorectal surgery.
REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420251139372.

papers.title_zh: 吲哚青綠螢光血管顯影（ICG-FA）預防大腸直腸手術吻合口洩漏：分級系統性回顧與統合分析暨隨機對照試驗序列分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：吻合口洩漏（AL）是大腸直腸切除術後主要的併發症來源。吲哚青綠螢光血管顯影（ICG-FA）提供術中即時灌流評估，但其在隨機試驗中的效果仍有爭議。本篇綜述旨在評估ICG-FA相較於傳統術中評估在預防大腸直腸手術吻合口洩漏上的療效與安全性。

方法：依循PRISMA準則進行系統性回顧與統合分析，納入比較ICG-FA與傳統評估的RCT。主要outcome為整體AL；次要outcome包括洩漏等級、解剖位置、手術指標、及手術計畫改變（CISP）。使用隨機效應或固定效應模型計算合併風險比（RR）或平均差（MD）及95%信賴區間。以試驗序列分析（TSA）評估證據是否充足。

結果：8篇RCT（n=4712）符合納入條件。ICG-FA相較對照組降低整體AL（RR 0.68，95% CI 0.58-0.81；I2=0%）。絕對風險降低為3.6%，換算需治療人數（NNT）約為24人以預防一例洩漏。TSA顯示主要endpoint已跨越優越性邊界，表示假定對照組風險與效應量的證據已充足。左側吻合口與較低等級洩漏（A級及A+B級）的效益較明顯，而嚴重（C級）洩漏與再手術率則無顯著差異。整體併發症呈現小幅相對降低，但TSA顯示資訊量仍不足。其他安全性outcome（手術部位感染、腸阻塞、死亡率）兩組相似。

結論：高確定性證據顯示ICG-FA可降低整體及低等級AL，主要見於左側切除術，且不延長手術時間。ICG-FA應被視為大腸直腸手術中優化灌流評估的實證輔助工具。

註冊：PROSPERO CRD420251139372。

papers.title: Effect of exercise on memory function and daily activities after colorectal cancer surgery: an exploratory secondary analysis from the randomised trial PHYSSURG-C
papers.authors: Ehrencrona C, Li Y, Afshari K, Angenete E, Buratti S, Larsson C
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To explore the effect of a short-term unsupervised exercise intervention on memory function and activities of daily living after surgery for colorectal cancer.
DESIGN: Secondary analysis within a randomised controlled open label trial with central computerised 1:1 parallel allocation.
SETTING: One university and five regional hospitals in Sweden. Recruitment period 2015-2020.
INTERVENTION: Moderately intense aerobic physical activity 30 minutes a day, 2 weeks before and 4 weeks after surgery.
PARTICIPANTS: Patients with colorectal cancer undergoing elective curative surgery. Of the 761 randomised, 631 completed the study and were analysed (intervention 296/379, control 335/382). Median age 70 years, 61% men.
OUTCOME MEASURES: Self-reported memory function and activities of daily living. Questionnaires were distributed at inclusion and at 4 weeks and 12 months postoperatively.
RESULTS: There was no difference in self-reported memory function between the groups at 4 weeks. At 12 months, participants in the intervention group were less likely to report being told they had poor memory (OR 0.61, 95% CI 0.38 to 0.98). Regarding daily activities, participants in the intervention group were more likely to report a greater ability to shop for food or other necessities at 4 weeks (OR 1.53, 95% CI 1.07 to 2.20). No other significant differences were seen.
CONCLUSION: This exploratory study with secondary data, nested in a multicentre randomised trial, found no substantial effects of a short-term unsupervised exercise intervention on memory function or the ability to perform daily activities in patients with colorectal cancer. An exercise intervention of this duration and intensity could be insufficient for improvement compared with standard care.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT02299596.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：探討短期非監督式運動介入對大腸直腸癌手術後記憶功能與日常生活活動能力之影響。設計：於一項開放標籤、中央電腦化1:1平行分組隨機對照試驗中進行之次分析。場域：瑞典一所大學醫院與五所地區醫院，收案期間為2015-2020年。介入：中等強度有氧運動，每日30分鐘，於手術前2週及手術後4週進行。參與者：接受選擇性根治性大腸直腸癌手術之病患。761名隨機分派病患中，631名完成研究並納入分析（介入組296/379，對照組335/382）。中位年齡70歲，61%為男性。結果測量：自評記憶功能與日常生活活動能力。問卷於納入時、術後4週及12個月時發放。結果：兩組於術後4週之自評記憶功能無差異。於12個月時，介入組較不易被告知記憶力不佳（OR 0.61，95% CI 0.38至0.98）。關於日常活動，介入組於4週時更可能報告有較佳能力自行採買食物或生活必需品（OR 1.53，95% CI 1.07至2.20）。未見其他顯著差異。結論：此為巢式於多中心隨機試驗中之次資料探索性研究，發現短期非監督式運動介入對大腸直腸癌病患之記憶功能或日常活動執行能力並無實質影響。此種持續時間與強度之運動介入，相較於標準照護可能不足以產生改善效果。試驗註冊號：NCT02299596。

papers.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Colorectal Cancer Screening Via Fecal Occult Blood Testing: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Frankenfeld M, Patah G, Soares L, Silva S, Romeiro F, Nogueira V
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of population-based colorectal cancer (CRC) screening programs using fecal occult blood tests (gFOBT or FIT) among adults aged 45-75 years.
METHODS: We included studies comparing participants in population-based CRC screening programs with unscreened individuals. Outcomes were all-cause mortality, CRC-specific mortality, CRC incidence, and stage IV CRC incidence. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Pooled RRs were calculated by meta-analysis, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: No difference was observed in all-cause mortality (RR = 1.00, 95% CI 0.99-1.01; 5 studies, 1,474,576 participants; moderate-certainty evidence). RCTs evaluating gFOBT demonstrated a reduction in CRC-specific mortality (RR = 0.89, 95% CI 0.84-0.94; 5 studies, 1,474,576 participants; moderate-certainty evidence), corresponding to 38 fewer CRC deaths per 100,000 individuals screened (95% CI, 55 fewer to 21 fewer). Non-RCTs evaluating FIT reported larger reductions in CRC-specific mortality (RR = 0.21, 95% CI 0.20-0.21; 5 studies, 7,435,956 participants), although the certainty of evidence was low. RCTs showed no significant effect on CRC incidence or stage IV CRC incidence, whereas non-RCTs evaluating FIT suggested reductions in both outcomes; however, the certainty of evidence was also low.
CONCLUSION: Fecal occult blood test-based screening reduces CRC-specific mortality but not all-cause mortality. FIT-based screening may provide additional benefits by reducing CRC incidence and stage IV disease; however, these findings are supported by low-certainty evidence and require confirmation in RCTs.

papers.title_zh: 糞便潛血檢測用於大腸直腸癌篩檢之有效性與安全性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本系統性回顧評估以糞便潛血檢測（gFOBT或FIT）為基礎之族群性大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢計畫，在45-75歲成人中的有效性。方法：納入比較族群性CRC篩檢計畫參與者與未篩檢者之研究。結果指標包括全因死亡率、CRC特異性死亡率、CRC發生率及第四期CRC發生率。兩位審閱者獨立進行研究篩選、資料萃取與偏誤風險評估。以統合分析計算彙整RR，並以GRADE評估證據確定性。結果：全因死亡率無差異（RR = 1.00，95% CI 0.99-1.01；5篇研究，1,474,576名參與者；中等確定性證據）。評估gFOBT之RCT顯示CRC特異性死亡率降低（RR = 0.89，95% CI 0.84-0.94；5篇研究，1,474,576名參與者；中等確定性證據），相當於每篩檢10萬人減少38例CRC死亡（95% CI，減少55例至減少21例）。評估FIT之非RCT研究則報告更大幅度的CRC特異性死亡率降低（RR = 0.21，95% CI 0.20-0.21；5篇研究，7,435,956名參與者），但證據確定性為低。RCT顯示對CRC發生率或第四期CRC發生率無顯著影響，而評估FIT之非RCT則顯示兩項結果皆有降低，惟證據確定性亦為低。結論：以糞便潛血檢測為基礎之篩檢可降低CRC特異性死亡率，但不影響全因死亡率。以FIT為基礎之篩檢可能提供額外益處，降低CRC發生率與第四期疾病，惟此發現僅由低確定性證據支持，仍需RCT證實。

papers.title: Multicentre, prospective, observational study on the effectiveness and safety of upadacitinib for active perianal fistulising Crohn's disease in patients with prior anti-tumour necrosis factor failure: a study protocol
papers.authors: Lu C, Xu D, Qian K, Dou L, Ding Y, Fa J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Perianal fistulising Crohn's disease (pfCD) is a debilitating phenotype and remains a therapeutic challenge. Current guidelines recommend anti-tumour necrosis factor agents as first-line therapy for pfCD; however, there is still no consensus on the optimal pharmacological strategy once anti-TNF therapy fails. Upadacitinib, an oral selective Janus kinase 1 inhibitor, has demonstrated efficacy in moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease. Nevertheless, real-world data specifically addressing its effectiveness and safety in the refractory pfCD population remain scarce. This study aims to evaluate the real-world effectiveness and safety of upadacitinib in patients with active pfCD who have failed anti-TNF therapy.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This is a multicentre, prospective, observational cohort study. A total of 90 adult patients with Crohn's disease-associated perianal fistulas with active drainage and refractory to prior therapy with infliximab or adalimumab will be enrolled. Patients with severe luminal disease, undrained abscesses >2 cm, anal stenosis or diverting stomas will be excluded. Participants will receive upadacitinib 45 mg/day during the induction phase, followed by 15 or 30 mg/day during maintenance. All treatment decisions are made according to routine clinical practice and local product labels, not mandated by the study protocol, including upadacitinib dosing, dose adjustments and concomitant therapies. The primary outcome is a composite of clinical and radiological fistula response at week 12. Secondary outcomes, assessed at weeks 12 and 52, include perianal fistula-related, CD-related and safety outcomes.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, Renji Hospital Ethics Committee has reviewed and approved this study (Approval No: LY2025-024-A). Findings will be disseminated through publication in peer-reviewed journals, presentations at scientific conferences and summaries provided to the participating institutions and relevant patient communities.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：肛門周圍瘻管化Crohn氏症（pfCD）是一種令人衰弱的表現型，仍是治療上的挑戰。現行指引建議抗腫瘤壞死因子藥物作為pfCD的第一線治療，然而在抗TNF治療失敗後，最佳藥物治療策略仍無共識。Upadacitinib是一種口服選擇性Janus激酶1抑制劑，已證實對中重度Crohn氏症有效。然而，針對難治性pfCD族群其療效與安全性的真實世界資料仍然稀少。本研究旨在評估upadacitinib在抗TNF治療失敗之活動性pfCD患者中的真實世界療效與安全性。

方法與分析：這是一項多中心、前瞻性、觀察性世代研究。將納入共90名因Crohn氏症相關肛門周圍瘻管而有活動性引流、且對先前infliximab或adalimumab治療無效的成年患者。將排除嚴重腸腔內病灶、未引流膿瘍>2公分、肛門狹窄或造口分流之患者。參與者於誘導期將接受upadacitinib 45毫克/天，維持期則接受15或30毫克/天。所有治療決策皆依常規臨床實務及當地藥品仿單進行，包括upadacitinib劑量、劑量調整及合併治療，均不受研究方案強制規定。主要結果為第12週時臨床與影像學瘻管反應之複合指標。次要結果將於第12週及第52週評估，包括肛門周圍瘻管相關、Crohn氏症相關及安全性結果。

倫理與傳播：上海交通大學醫學院附屬仁濟醫院倫理委員會已審查並核准本研究（核准號：LY2025-024-A）。研究結果將透過同儕審查期刊發表、學術會議報告，以及向參與機構與相關病友社群提供摘要來傳播。

papers.title: Systemic-local immune remodeling in colorectal cancer: CD14+ cell-derived cytokine responsiveness, mucosal immune-cell organization, and exploratory metastasis-associated patterns
papers.authors: Shakhpazyan N, Mikhaleva L, Sadykhov N, Konyukova A, Bedzhanyan A, Gioeva Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Immune regulatory networks contribute to colorectal cancer (CRC) progression, but most clinical studies focus on tissue immune-cell abundance or static inflammatory mediators. We investigated cytokine-response patterns in cultures derived from peripheral-blood CD14+ cells and local immune-cell composition in tumor-adjacent and resection-margin mucosa.
METHODS: This single-center prospective observational study included 106 patients with colorectal adenocarcinoma and 20 comparison subjects with non-malignant surgical conditions. Peripheral-blood CD14+ cells were isolated, differentiated with M-CSF, and subjected to sequential LPS stimulation. IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8, and MCP-1 concentrations were measured, and cytokine-response indices were calculated. In CRC patients, CD4+, CD8+, CD20+, CD56+, and CD68+ cell densities were quantified immunohistochemically in paired mucosal compartments. Analyses addressed CRC-associated differences, local immune-cell organization, systemic-local associations, and an exploratory comparison between patients without distant metastases (n = 97) and patients with distant metastases (n = 9).
RESULTS: CRC was associated with selective remodeling of IL-1β and IL-6 response indices. Compared with the comparison group, CRC patients showed higher IL-1β post-washout persistence, lower shutdown efficiency and re-induction capacity, and a higher re-stimulation index. IL-6 responses were characterized by lower basal activity but higher basal drift, primary LPS response, and post-washout persistence. The exploratory comparison according to distant metastasis status identified additional differences in selected IL-1β and IL-6 indices, however, these findings are limited by the small number of patients with distant metastases. Locally, CD20+ cells were enriched in tumor-adjacent mucosa, whereas CD68+ cells were enriched in resection-margin mucosa. Matched immune-cell densities were positively correlated across compartments. The strongest systemic-local association was an inverse correlation between MCP-1 primary LPS response and CD68+ cell density in tumor-adjacent mucosa.
CONCLUSIONS: CRC is associated with altered cytokine responsiveness in M-CSF-differentiated cultures derived from blood CD14+ cells and with compartment-specific mucosal immune-cell organization. The observed systemic-local associations suggest partial coupling between these experimental and tissue-level immune features. Exploratory metastasis-associated patterns were identified but require validation in larger, adequately powered cohorts.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的全身-局部免疫重塑：CD14+細胞衍生之細胞激素反應性、黏膜免疫細胞組織，及探索性轉移相關模式
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：免疫調控網絡參與大腸直腸癌（CRC）進展，但多數臨床研究聚焦於組織免疫細胞豐度或靜態發炎介質。本研究探討周邊血CD14+細胞培養的細胞激素反應模式，以及腫瘤旁與切除邊緣黏膜之局部免疫細胞組成。
方法：此為單中心前瞻性觀察性研究，納入106名大腸直腸腺癌患者及20名非惡性外科疾病之對照者。分離周邊血CD14+細胞，以M-CSF分化後進行序列LPS刺激。測量IL-1β、IL-6、IL-8及MCP-1濃度，並計算細胞激素反應指標。在CRC患者中，以免疫組織化學法量化配對黏膜區域之CD4+、CD8+、CD20+、CD56+、CD68+細胞密度。分析涵蓋CRC相關差異、局部免疫細胞組織、全身-局部關聯性，以及無遠端轉移患者（n=97）與有遠端轉移患者（n=9）之探索性比較。
結果：CRC與IL-1β及IL-6反應指標的選擇性重塑相關。與對照組相比，CRC患者顯示較高的IL-1β洗滌後持續性、較低的關閉效率與再誘導能力，以及較高的再刺激指數。IL-6反應特徵為較低的基礎活性，但較高的基礎漂移、初級LPS反應及洗滌後持續性。依遠端轉移狀態進行的探索性比較，發現部分IL-1β及IL-6指標有額外差異，但此發現受限於轉移患者人數過少。局部方面，CD20+細胞於腫瘤旁黏膜富集，而CD68+細胞於切除邊緣黏膜富集。配對免疫細胞密度在各區域間呈正相關。最強的全身-局部關聯為MCP-1初級LPS反應與腫瘤旁黏膜CD68+細胞密度之負相關。
結論：CRC與血液CD14+細胞衍生、M-CSF分化培養中細胞激素反應性改變，以及區域特異性黏膜免疫細胞組織相關。觀察到的全身-局部關聯提示這些實驗層級與組織層級免疫特徵間存在部分耦合。探索性轉移相關模式已被發現，但需在更大規模、統計檢力足夠的族群中驗證。

papers.title: The DCBLD2 super-enhancer drives colorectal cancer progression through FOSL2/JUND-mediated activation of the CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B pathway
papers.authors: Wu T, Shao L, Hu X, He H, Chen L, Feng M
papers.abstract: Super-enhancers are clusters of cis-regulatory elements that sustain the expression of cell-identity genes. Their aberrant activation or dysfunction constitutes a hallmark of malignant cellular transformation, which frequently rewires oncogenic transcriptional programs to support uncontrolled cell proliferation and metastatic potential. However, the functions and epigenetic regulation mechanisms of colorectal cancer specific super-enhancers remain poorly understood, and few studies have focused on dissecting how tumor enriched super-enhancers mediate downstream oncogenic signaling in CRC. By integrating multi-omics sequencing data, we identified a highly active super-enhancer in colorectal cancer, termed DCBLD2-SE. Through luciferase reporter assays, the SE3-2 subregion was identified as the minimal functional core of this super-enhancer. Mechanistic studies confirmed that transcription factors of the activator protein-1 family (FOSL2 and JUND) can bind directly to the SE3-2 cis-regulatory element, synergistically regulating local chromatin remodeling and strongly driving the upregulation of the target gene DCBLD2. Following knockout of the DCBLD2-SE core region, the malignant proliferative capacity of colorectal cancer cells decreased significantly, and the growth of xenograft tumors in vivo was markedly inhibited. Functionally, DCBLD2-SE facilitates tumor progression through a DCBLD2-dependent CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B signaling axis. Clinically, high expression of DCBLD2 correlates with malignant metastasis and poor overall survival in patients with colorectal cancer. In summary, this study uncovers a previously undescribed DCBLD2-centered regulatory cascade that promotes colorectal cancer initiation and progression. DCBLD2-SE and its binding transcription factor activator protein-1 represent promising prognostic biomarkers and actionable therapeutic targets for colorectal cancer.

papers.abstract_zh: 超增強子是維持細胞身份基因表現的順式調控元件叢集。其異常活化或功能失調是惡性細胞轉化的標誌之一，經常重塑致癌轉錄程式以支持不受控的細胞增殖與轉移潛能。然而，大腸直腸癌特異性超增強子的功能與表觀遺傳調控機制仍所知有限，鮮少研究聚焦於解析腫瘤富集的超增強子如何介導下游致癌訊息傳遞。透過整合多體學定序數據，我們鑑定出一個在大腸直腸癌中高度活躍的超增強子，命名為DCBLD2-SE。透過螢光素酶報告基因分析，SE3-2次區域被鑑定為此超增強子的最小功能核心。機轉研究證實，活化蛋白-1家族的轉錄因子（FOSL2與JUND）可直接結合SE3-2順式調控元件，協同調控局部染色質重塑，並強力驅動標的基因DCBLD2的上調表現。剔除DCBLD2-SE核心區域後，大腸直腸癌細胞的惡性增殖能力顯著下降，體內異種移植腫瘤生長亦受到明顯抑制。功能上，DCBLD2-SE透過DCBLD2依賴性的CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B訊息軸促進腫瘤進展。臨床上，DCBLD2高表現與大腸直腸癌病人的惡性轉移及較差整體存活相關。總結而言，本研究揭露了一個先前未被描述、以DCBLD2為中心的調控串聯，促進大腸直腸癌的起始與進展。DCBLD2-SE及其結合轉錄因子活化蛋白-1代表大腸直腸癌具潛力的預後生物標記與可作用治療標的。

papers.title: Gut microbiota-innate immune crosstalk in the initiation and progression of CRC: mechanisms and therapeutic potential
papers.authors: Lin J, Lin H, Zhang Z, Wang H
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a common malignancy of the digestive system, and its initiation and progression are associated with multiple factors, including genetic alterations, environmental exposures, changes in the gut microbiota, and disruption of immune homeostasis. In recent years, evidence from human observational studies, animal models, and in vitro experiments has shown that the gut microbiota can influence Toll-like receptor and NOD-like receptor signaling, NF-κB activation, the NLRP3 inflammasome, and immunometabolic pathways through multiple mechanisms, including microbial structural components, metabolic signals, virulence factors, and outer membrane vesicles. These effects are associated with functional remodeling of innate immune components such as macrophages, dendritic cells, neutrophils, and natural killer (NK) cells. Conversely, the innate immune system can reshape microbial composition, spatial distribution, and metabolic characteristics through antimicrobial effector molecules, maintenance of the mucosal barrier, release of inflammatory mediators, and phagocytic clearance, indicating a bidirectional regulatory relationship between the gut microbiota and innate immunity. Current evidence suggests that microbiota-innate immune interactions are associated, to varying degrees, with CRC-related pathological processes, including alterations in immune surveillance and the myeloid microenvironment, barrier dysfunction, low-grade inflammation, remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related phenotypes, and immune evasion. Notably, colibactin-associated mutational signatures have been directly demonstrated in the genomes of human CRC tumors, representing one of the relatively rare forms of high-strength mechanistic evidence in microbiota-CRC research. Beyond such a limited number of well-supported mechanisms, however, many specific microbiota-immune interactions and their roles at different pathological stages remain based primarily on animal models, in vitro experiments, or integrative inference, while longitudinal causal evidence in humans remains generally limited. This review focuses on the bidirectional interactions between the gut microbiota and innate immunity in CRC, systematically summarizing their molecular mechanisms, associated pathological processes, and advances in microbiota-targeted interventions, with particular emphasis on distinguishing among different types of evidence, experimental contexts, and levels of causal certainty. In doing so, we aim to provide a more cautious theoretical basis for mechanistic research on the microbiota-immune axis and for the development of precision intervention strategies in CRC.

papers.title_zh: 腸道菌群與先天性免疫在CRC起始與進展中的交互作用：機制與治療潛力
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是消化系統常見的惡性腫瘤，其起始與進展與多重因素相關，包括基因變異、環境暴露、腸道菌群改變以及免疫homeostasis失衡。近年來，來自人類觀察性研究、動物模型及體外實驗的證據顯示，腸道菌群可透過多種機制—包括微生物結構成分、代謝訊號、毒力因子及外膜囊泡—影響Toll-like receptor與NOD-like receptor訊號傳導、NF-κB活化、NLRP3發炎小體以及免疫代謝路徑。這些效應與巨噬細胞、樹突細胞、嗜中性球及自然殺手（NK）細胞等先天性免疫成分的功能重塑相關。反之，先天性免疫系統可透過抗菌效應分子、黏膜屏障維持、發炎介質釋放及吞噬清除，重塑微生物組成、空間分布及代謝特徵，顯示腸道菌群與先天性免疫之間存在雙向調控關係。目前證據顯示，菌群-先天性免疫交互作用與CRC相關病理過程—包括免疫監視改變、骨髓性微環境改變、屏障功能障礙、低度發炎、腫瘤微環境重塑、上皮間質轉化相關表型及免疫逃逸—在不同程度上相關。值得注意的是，colibactin相關突變特徵已直接在人類CRC腫瘤基因組中證實，代表菌群-CRC研究中相對少數具高強度機制證據的例子之一。然而，除了這些少數已充分證實的機制外，許多特定的菌群-免疫交互作用及其在不同病理階段的角色，主要仍基於動物模型、體外實驗或整合推論，人類縱向因果證據普遍仍有限。本綜述聚焦於腸道菌群與先天性免疫在CRC中的雙向交互作用，系統性總結其分子機制、相關病理過程及以菌群為靶標的介入進展，並特別強調區分不同類型的證據、實驗情境及因果確定性等級。藉此，我們期望為菌群-免疫軸的機制研究以及CRC精準介入策略的開發，提供更謹慎的理論基礎。

papers.title: Macrophage pyroptosis in inflammatory bowel disease: mechanistic insights, pathological roles and treatment strategies
papers.authors: Yu Z, Zhao Z, Tian Y, Xue G, Wang J, Li Y
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorder of the intestinal tract. Imbalanced intestinal immune homeostasis, particularly macrophage pyroptosis, plays a central role in the pathogenesis of IBD. Pyroptosis is a pro-inflammatory form of programmed cell death mediated by the gasdermin protein family. It is characterized by cellular swelling, membrane rupture, and the massive release of inflammatory mediators. Under physiological conditions, moderate pyroptosis contributes to the maintenance of intestinal immune homeostasis by eliminating intracellular pathogens and releasing immunomodulatory signals. However, aberrant activation of pyroptosis triggers the excessive release of inflammatory mediators and damage signals that drive the initiation and progression of intestinal inflammation. Recent studies have shown that macrophage pyroptosis is profoundly involved in the pathological evolution of IBD. Upon stimulation by danger signals, macrophages undergo pyroptosis and release a high amount of inflammatory mediators that remodel the local immune network. Macrophage pyroptosis can also directly impair the intestinal mucosal barrier, thereby driving the pathological progression of IBD. This article systematically reviews the molecular mechanisms involved in pyroptosis, summarizes the pathological mechanisms through which macrophage pyroptosis drives IBD progression, and introduces various therapeutic strategies targeting macrophage pyroptosis to alleviate IBD. Finally, this review provides novel perspectives for the mechanistic research and precision treatment of IBD and facilitates the clinical translation of strategies targeting macrophage pyroptosis.

papers.title_zh: 巨噬細胞焦亡在發炎性腸道疾病中的角色：機轉洞見、病理角色與治療策略
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種慢性、反覆發作的腸道發炎性疾病。腸道免疫homeostasis失衡，特別是巨噬細胞焦亡（pyroptosis），在IBD致病機轉中扮演核心角色。焦亡是一種由gasdermin蛋白家族所媒介的促發炎程式性細胞死亡，其特徵為細胞腫脹、細胞膜破裂，以及大量發炎介質釋放。在生理狀態下，適度的焦亡透過清除細胞內病原體及釋放免疫調節訊號，有助於維持腸道免疫homeostasis。然而，焦亡異常活化會觸發過量發炎介質與損傷訊號釋放，驅動腸道發炎的起始與進展。近期研究顯示，巨噬細胞焦亡深度參與IBD的病理演變。在危險訊號刺激下，巨噬細胞發生焦亡並釋放大量發炎介質，重塑局部免疫網絡。巨噬細胞焦亡亦可直接損害腸道黏膜屏障，進而驅動IBD病理進展。本文系統性回顧焦亡相關分子機轉，總結巨噬細胞焦亡驅動IBD進展的病理機轉，並介紹針對巨噬細胞焦亡以緩解IBD的各種治療策略。最後，本綜述為IBD機轉研究與精準治療提供新觀點，並促進針對巨噬細胞焦亡策略的臨床轉譯。

papers.title: Interplay between pathogen-mediated immune evasion and innate immune negative regulation in gastrointestinal tumors
papers.authors: Shi M, Zeng Y, Chen C, Zuo X
papers.abstract: Persistent colonization by gastrointestinal pathogens is an important environmental factor contributing to the development and progression of gastric and colorectal cancer. Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), Fusobacterium nucleatum (F. nucleatum), enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF), and pks-positive Escherichia coli (E. coli) can induce chronic inflammation and reshape the tumor microenvironment via virulence factors, epithelial barrier disruption, DNA damage, and immune dysregulation. Conventional views have largely focused on the tumor-promoting effects of chronic inflammation; however, this view does not fully explain the coexsistence of persistent inflammation and immune evasion during chronic infection. In this review, we proposed that the key feature of pathogen-associated inflammation is not simply its intensity but rather the imbalance between sustained inflammatory stimulation and insufficient immune elimination. Rather than treating pathogen-mediated immune evasion, host-derived innate immune negative regulation, and adaptive immune checkpoint suppression as parallel mechanisms, this review examined how these functionally distinct layers converge in gastrointestinal tumors. Pathogen immune evasion allows persistent microbial stimulation, host negative-feedback pathways dampen PRR- and interferon (IFN)-associated signaling, and checkpoint-mediated suppression further impairs cytotoxic clearance. Together, these processes create a state in which sustained inflammation coexists with insufficient immune elimination. This state can impair antigen presentation, cytotoxic immune responses, and pathogen clearance, thereby promoting immune tolerance and tumor progression. Understanding this mechanism may offer a conceptual basis for pathogen control, innate immune reprogramming, and precision therapeutic intervention in gastrointestinal tumors.

papers.title_zh: 病原體免疫逃逸與先天性免疫負向調節在腸胃道腫瘤中的交互作用
papers.abstract_zh: 腸胃道病原體的持續定殖是胃癌與大腸直腸癌發生與進展的重要環境因子。幽門螺旋桿菌（H. pylori）、EB病毒（EBV）、具核梭桿菌（F. nucleatum）、產腸毒素脆弱擬桿菌（ETBF）、以及pks陽性大腸桿菌（E. coli）可透過毒力因子、上皮屏障破壞、DNA損傷與免疫失調誘發慢性發炎並重塑腫瘤微環境。傳統觀點主要聚焦於慢性發炎的促腫瘤效應，然而此觀點無法完全解釋慢性感染期間持續發炎與免疫逃逸並存的現象。本綜述提出，病原體相關發炎的關鍵特徵並非單純其強度，而是持續發炎刺激與免疫清除不足之間的失衡。本文不將病原體介導的免疫逃逸、宿主先天免疫負向調節、以及後天免疫檢查點抑制視為平行機制，而是檢視這些功能上不同的層面如何在腸胃道腫瘤中匯聚。病原體免疫逃逸使微生物持續刺激得以存在，宿主負反饋路徑抑制PRR與干擾素（IFN）相關訊號，而檢查點介導的抑制進一步損害細胞毒性清除能力。這些過程共同造成持續發炎與免疫清除不足並存的狀態。此狀態可損害抗原呈現、細胞毒性免疫反應與病原體清除，進而促進免疫耐受與腫瘤進展。理解此機制可為腸胃道腫瘤的病原體控制、先天免疫重編程與精準治療干預提供概念基礎。

papers.title: Associations of CT-Derived Skeletal Muscle Index and Density With Postoperative Outcomes Following Colorectal Cancer Surgery
papers.journal_full: Journal of cachexia, sarcopenia and muscle
papers.authors: Papadopoulos E, Irving B, Spielmann G, Lin M, Finan K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Preoperative skeletal muscle index (SMI) and skeletal muscle density (SMD) are gaining attention as predictors of postoperative outcomes following colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery. We examined the associations between computed tomography (CT)-based SMI and SMD with postoperative outcomes following CRC resection.
METHODS: This was a retrospective cohort study of patients who were surgically treated for CRC at a regional hospital in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, United States, from October 2018 to February 2024. CT-based SMI (cm2/m2) and SMD (Hounsfield units) at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) were used as continuous and binary predictors in multivariable analyses. Low SMI and low SMD were each defined based on two common definitions. Outcomes included length of stay (LOS), severe postoperative complications, discharge location, 90-day mortality and overall mortality (OM). The associations of SMI and SMD with LOS were examined using negative binomial regression. Logistic regression was used to examine the associations of SMI and SMD with severe postoperative complications and discharge location. Survival analysis was used to determine the associations of SMI and SMD with 90-day mortality and OM.
RESULTS: A total of 415 patients (mean age 63.7, SD 13.2) were included in the analysis, of whom 189 (45.5%) were females. The median LOS was 4 days, while 50 (12.0%) of patients experienced at least one severe postoperative complication. A total of 30 (7.2%) patients were discharged to a non-home location, while 12 (2.9%) patients died within 90 days. Over a median follow-up of 31.6 months, 75 (18.1%) patients died. In multivariable analyses, each 5-unit decrease in SMD was associated with increased LOS (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 1.06, 95%CI 1.02-1.10, p = 0.003), greater odds of severe postoperative complications (odds ratio [OR] 1.25, 95%CI 1.02-1.53, p = 0.029) and non-home discharge (OR 1.40, 95%CI 1.09-1.79, p = 0.007), as well as a higher risk of OM (hazard ratio [HR] 1.26, 95%CI 1.09-1.46, p = 0.002). In unadjusted analysis, each 5-unit decrease in SMD was significantly associated with 90-day mortality (HR 1.36, 95%CI 1.04-1.78, p = 0.024). Low SMD based on two different definitions predicted LOS (IRR 1.21, 95%CI 1.05-1.41, p = 0.010; IRR 1.28, 95%CI 1.11-1.48. p < 0.001), while only one definition was significantly associated with a higher risk of OM (HR 1.93, 95%CI 1.08-3.43, p = 0.027). SMI as a continuous or binary predictor was not significantly associated with postoperative outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: CT-based SMD rather than SMI appears to be a more relevant predictor of postoperative outcomes following CRC surgery. Future research should explore whether prehabilitation can improve SMD prior to CRC surgery.

papers.title_zh: CT測量骨骼肌指數（SMI）與骨骼肌密度（SMD）與大腸直腸癌術後預後之相關性
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：術前骨骼肌指數（SMI）與骨骼肌密度（SMD）作為大腸直腸癌（CRC）術後預後之預測因子日益受到重視。本研究探討CT測量之SMI與SMD與CRC切除術後預後之相關性。方法：本研究為回溯性世代研究，納入2018年10月至2024年2月間於美國路易斯安那州Baton Rouge一區域醫院接受CRC手術之病人。以第三腰椎（L3）處CT測量之SMI（cm2/m2）與SMD（Hounsfield units）作為連續變項與二分變項，納入多變項分析。低SMI與低SMD分別依兩種常用定義判定。預後指標包括住院天數（LOS）、嚴重術後併發症、出院去處、90天死亡率與整體死亡率（OM）。以負二項回歸分析SMI、SMD與LOS之關係；以邏輯回歸分析SMI、SMD與嚴重術後併發症、出院去處之關係；以生存分析評估SMI、SMD與90天死亡率、OM之關係。結果：共納入415名病人（平均年齡63.7歲，SD 13.2），其中189名（45.5%）為女性。中位LOS為4天，50名（12.0%）病人發生至少一項嚴重術後併發症。共30名（7.2%）病人出院至非居家處所，12名（2.9%）病人於90天內死亡。中位追蹤31.6個月期間，75名（18.1%）病人死亡。多變項分析顯示，SMD每下降5單位，與LOS增加相關（發生率比[IRR] 1.06，95%CI 1.02-1.10，p=0.003）、嚴重術後併發症風險上升（勝算比[OR] 1.25，95%CI 1.02-1.53，p=0.029）、非居家出院風險上升（OR 1.40，95%CI 1.09-1.79，p=0.007），以及整體死亡率風險上升（風險比[HR] 1.26，95%CI 1.09-1.46，p=0.002）。未調整分析中，SMD每下降5單位與90天死亡率顯著相關（HR 1.36，95%CI 1.04-1.78，p=0.024）。以兩種不同定義判定之低SMD均可預測LOS（IRR 1.21，95%CI 1.05-1.41，p=0.010；IRR 1.28，95%CI 1.11-1.48，p<0.001），僅其中一種定義與整體死亡率顯著相關（HR 1.93，95%CI 1.08-3.43，p=0.027）。無論作為連續變項或二分變項，SMI均未與術後預後顯著相關。結論：相較於SMI，CT測量之SMD似為CRC術後預後更相關之預測因子。未來研究應探討術前復健（prehabilitation）是否能改善SMD。

papers.title: Emerging roles of SLC6A14 in digestive system diseases: from amino acid transport to therapeutic targeting
papers.authors: Xia Q, Sun J, Yu Q, Li J, Zhou B, Zhu L
papers.abstract: The solute carrier (SLC) family comprises a large group of membrane transport proteins responsible for the transmembrane transport of nutrients, ions, metabolites, and drugs. SLC6A14 (solute carrier family 6 member 14) is a Na+ and Cl--dependent amino acid transporter with broad substrate specificity, capable of transporting a broad spectrum of neutral and cationic amino acids, thereby supporting cellular nutrient uptake and metabolic homeostasis. Altered expression, genetic variation, or dysregulated function of SLC6A14 has been implicated in inflammatory bowel disease, cystic fibrosis-associated gastrointestinal phenotypes, and several digestive system cancers, including gastric, colorectal, and pancreatic cancers. Dysregulation of SLC6A14 has been implicated in intestinal epithelial injury, regulation of intestinal fluid secretion, and tumor cell proliferation and metastasis. Together, these observations support a broad but context-dependent role for SLC6A14 in digestive system diseases. This review summarizes the transport properties of SLC6A14 and current knowledge of its functions in digestive system diseases, with a focus on its potential as a disease biomarker and therapeutic target.

papers.title_zh: SLC6A14在消化系統疾病中的新興角色：從胺基酸轉運到治療標的
papers.abstract_zh: 溶質載體（SLC）家族包含一大群負責跨膜轉運營養物質、離子、代謝物與藥物的膜運輸蛋白。SLC6A14（溶質載體家族6成員14）是一種依賴Na+與Cl-的胺基酸轉運蛋白，具有廣泛的受質專一性，能夠轉運多種中性與陽離子胺基酸，藉此支持細胞營養攝取與代謝恆定。SLC6A14的表現改變、基因變異或功能失調，已被牽涉於發炎性腸道疾病、囊狀纖維化相關腸胃道表現型，以及多種消化系統癌症（包括胃癌、大腸直腸癌與胰臟癌）。SLC6A14的失調亦被認為與腸道上皮損傷、腸道液體分泌調控，以及腫瘤細胞增生與轉移有關。整體而言，這些觀察支持SLC6A14在消化系統疾病中扮演廣泛但具情境依賴性的角色。本綜述總結SLC6A14的轉運特性，以及目前對其在消化系統疾病中功能的認識，並聚焦於其作為疾病生物標記與治療標的之潛力。
